Name: Bochim
Description: The place where the angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal and rebuked Israel for breaking covenant, and the people wept aloud and sacrificed there, calling the place Bochim, 'weepers'.
BiblicalSignificance: Bochim is where the conquest generation wept: the angel's rebuke met with tears and sacrifice at the start of the judges' troubled years.
